description: Eight party records at *0x685174 (stride 0x1862), presence bytes at *0x685178 (stride 0x106) and the UI object at *0x68c09c are inputs. 0x517970 (dice) and 0x520f90 (item search, mode 0, 12 slots) run natively. The D4 callees 0x52af50 and 0x52a890 and the excluded presentation helper 0x58ac00 are address-stubbed; the node ignores their returns (a scratch run with ret 0x5a5a5a5a stayed diff=0), so their call counts and every call's arguments are the outputs. Neighbour cells of every read field, the other fields of each item slot and the 8 mode-nonzero item slots hold decoys.
